source.title: Next Week on XBOX: New Games for September 28 to October 2
source.evidenceText: Mike Nelson, XBOX Wire Editor September 25, 2026 · 10 min read Welcome to Next Week on XBOX! In this weekly feature we cover all the games coming soon to XBOX Series X|S, XBOX One, XBOX on PC, and Game Pass! Get more details on these upcoming games below and click their profiles for further info (release dates subject to change). Let’s jump in! Minecraft Dungeons II Xbox Game Studios ☆☆☆☆☆ 503 ★★★★★ Get it now Minecraft Dungeons II – September 28Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Drop the pickaxe, grab a sword, and charge into a thrilling new adventure in Minecraft Dungeons II. Journey through unexplored lands and mysterious locations, in a quest to stop a new evil from causing chaos in not one, but two worlds! Clash with menacing foes in explosive encounters and fight your way through hordes of mobs that will do everything in their power to stop you! Gears of War: E-Day Premium Edition Pre-Order Xbox Game Studios ☆☆☆☆☆ 261 ★★★★★ Get it now Gears of War: E-Day Premium Edition – October 1XBOX Play Anywhere Experience the horror and brutality of Emergence Day. Fourteen years before the original Gears of War, join Marcus Fenix and Dominic Santiago in a gripping origin-story campaign as the Locust Horde first erupt from below, igniting a desperate fight for survival. Rally your squad and fight on in multiplayer with a reimagination of Gears’ iconic PvE mode, Horde Siege, or go head-to-head with a refined Versus PvP. Built from the ground up in Unreal Engine 5, Gears of War: E-Day delivers the most immersive Gears yet. ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE Pre-Order Bandai Namco Entertainment America Inc. ☆☆☆☆☆ 218 ★★★★★ Get it now Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve – October 2Step into the cockpit and take flight as an elite pilot across stunning skies. Enter intense dogfights, eliminate threats, and rise through gripping missions to earn your wings in this game developed by PROJECT ACES, the acclaimed team behind the franchise. Early Access starts September 28 for those who pre-order the Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve Deluxe Edition. The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered CD PROJEKT RED ☆☆☆☆☆ 6577 ★★★★★ $49.99 $24.99 Get it now Xbox One X Enhanced The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered – September 29XBOX Play Anywhere Free upgrade for all owners of The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt. Discover the definitive version of the award-winning dark fantasy role-playing game on September 29. The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered brings an array of improvements and modernizations to visuals, gameplay, character progression, and much more. Remastered also includes the acclaimed Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine expansions. Gothic II Complete Classic THQ Nordic ☆☆☆☆☆ 15 ★★★★★ $29.99 Get it now Gothic II Complete Classic – September 28 Gothic II Complete Classic brings together the excitement of Gothic II and the expansion Night of the Raven. You have torn down the magical barrier and freed the prisoners of the Valley of Mines. Now the former convicts roam the forests and mountains, causing trouble around the city of Khorinis. Way of the Hunter 2 THQ Nordic ☆☆☆☆☆ 106 ★★★★★ Get it now Way of the Hunter 2 – September 28 Feel the thrill of the hunt and keep an eye out for the wild and wonderous species that are roaming the wilderness. Hunt in North America and display big game like Moose, Elk, Bears, and Bison as well as, smaller animals like Rabbits, Turkeys and various other birds. DYNASTY WARRIORS 3: Complete Edition Remastered KOEI TECMO AMERICA ☆☆☆☆☆ 82 ★★★★★ Get it now Dynasty Warriors 3: Complete Edition Remastered – October 1 A striking revival of DYNASTY WARRIORS 3 and DYNASTY WARRIORS 3: Xtreme Legends, which established the foundation of the entire series. The complete cast of more than 40 officers and numerous battlefields beautifully recreated using Unreal Engine 5. Experience even more enjoyable and thrilling action as you aim for the peak of 1 vs. 1,000! End of Abyss Epic Games Publishing ☆☆☆☆☆ 79 ★★★★★ $29.99 Get it now Free Trial End of Abyss – October 1 In the depths of a mysterious underground compound, a mission to investigate disturbances of unknown origin spirals into a harrowing descent through a broken and abandoned world. Play as the young combat technician, Cel, as she uncovers the truth behind the facility’s derelict areas and confronts the monstrous creatures that roam them. Ultimate Admiral: Dreadnoughts Samustai LTD ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now Ultimate Admiral: Dreadnoughts – October 1XBOX Play Anywhere Ultimate Admiral: Dreadnoughts offers a unique opportunity to design and build countless variations of realistic looking warships combined with an extremely in-depth combat model. Recreate famous ships such as the HMS Dreadnought and countless speculative designs. Experiment and enjoy naval battles utilizing endless combinations of ship designs in technology eras between the years 1890 and 1950 for ten different nations. Keep Driving YCJY Games ☆☆☆☆☆ 10 ★★★★★ $17.99 Get it now Keep Driving – September 28 An atmospheric management RPG about life on the open road. Pick up hitchhikers, work odd jobs, customize and repair your car, and map your route across the country. Use upgrades, skills and items to overcome challenges. And remember to take it easy. You’re young. You have time. Blades & Battles QUByte Interactive ☆☆☆☆☆ 1 ★★★★★ $14.99 $12.74 Get it now Blades & Battles – September 28XBOX Play Anywhere Blades & Battles combines the spirit of ‘90s arcades with the fluidity of modern combat. Explore a fantasy world inspired by Arthurian legends and prove your skill against colossal bosses. Fight solo or invite a friend for local co-op and relive the glory of couch co-op battles. Lost in Loss Soroka Games ☆☆☆☆☆ 2 ★★★★★ $9.99 Get it now Lost in Loss – September 28XBOX Play Anywhere Hey, Detective! Ready for a strange case? Citizens are forgetting who they are — their true selves are slipping away. Will you help bring them back?
